items.body: Stock market today: BSE Sensex ended the session at 81,028.02, up 1,718 points or 2.17%. Nifty50 closed at 25,030.35, up 494 points or 2.01%. Global equities suffered a sharp sell-off amid fading enthusiasm for artificial intelligence (AI) stocks following US President Donald Trump’s defeat in the midterm elections.

items.title: Adhik reveals why he decided not to cast Naslen as Ajith's son in 'GBU'
items.body: <![CDATA[Adhik Ravichandran revealed his rationale for not selecting Naslen for the role of Ajith Kumar's son in 'Good Bad Ugly'. He felt that Naslen's character lacked depth, particularly as he transitions from hero roles. Instead, Karthikeya Dev was cast, enhancing the film's action dynamics. Interestingly, Naslen has now made his debut as an antagonist in Suriya's 'Scene', while Adhik gears up to film 'Daredevil' with Ajith Kumar post-Diwali.

items.title: Matt Damon talks about the one Hollywood role that he missed out on
items.body: <![CDATA[Matt Damon recently opened up about his feelings of remorse for passing on the role in 'Ted'. He described the screenplay as uproarious and recalled sharing it with friends for a good laugh. Damon lamented the time away from family while shooting in Boston, amplifying his sense of missed opportunity. Although he feels this way, he commended Mark Wahlberg for his impressive portrayal in the film.

items.title: Mahesh Bhatt reveals why he missed Ramayana premiere
items.body: <![CDATA[Mahesh Bhatt skipped the premiere of ‘Ramayana’, starring son-in-law Ranbir Kapoor, to watch it in a cinema hall among strangers, calling the experience ‘real’ and ‘organic’. He recalled first hearing the epic from his mother, praised director Nitesh Tiwari and the team, and admitted he was moved to tears as the credits rolled.

items.title: 'Scene' vs 'Mookuthi Amman 2' BO Day 1 [Live]: Suriya starrer takes the lead
items.body: <![CDATA[Suriya's action-packed thriller 'Scene' and Nayanthara's captivating fantasy sequel 'Mookuthi Amman 2' are set for release in cinemas on November 6, just in time for the Diwali holiday weekend. While 'Scene' is garnering positive buzz for Suriya’s compelling portrayal of a police officer, 'Mookuthi Amman 2' offers a whimsical blend of comedy and spirituality.

items.title: 'Ramayana: Part 1' box office collection day 2 (LIVE)
items.body: <![CDATA[The much-anticipated Ramayana: Rise of a Legend hit cinemas on November 5, achieving a remarkable Rs 64.85 crore net on its first day, exceeding Ranbir Kapoor's previous film's figures. To date, the film has accumulated Rs 73.40 crore net domestically. However, the Kannada version hasn't performed as well as hoped in contrast to its Hindi counterpart. The film's ongoing box office success will depend on its performance during the weekend.

items.title: Maatrubhumi: Salman's Galwan drama eyes Nov 20 release
items.body: <![CDATA[Salman Khan’s ‘Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace’ is reportedly set for a November 20 release, with its trailer arriving today and the censor certificate awaited. Inspired by the 2020 Galwan Valley clash, the Apoorva Lakhia film stars Salman as an Army officer alongside Chitrangda Singh. His next, ‘Monster’, targets Eid next year.

items.title: In 2000, one of Nicolas Cage’s rare comics was stolen; found 11 years later, and fetched USD 15 million at an auction
items.body: <![CDATA[The long-lost Superman comic once owned by Nicolas Cage, stolen in 2000, has made a remarkable comeback. Found in a deserted storage unit, its authenticity verified by authorities, the comic was auctioned by Cage for an astonishing USD 2.16 million in November 2011. More recently, it was sold privately for a staggering USD 15 million in January 2026, underscoring Cage's continuing fascination with the comic book universe.

items.title: Aditi Rao Hydari excited to celebrate Diwali with husband Siddharth
items.body: <![CDATA[Aditi Rao Hydari is looking forward to celebrating Diwali with her husband Siddharth in India this year. After Siddharth's work commitments kept them apart last year, they will finally be together for the festivities. Aditi hopes to visit home with Siddharth after the promotions of her upcoming film 'Parivarik ManuRanjan'. The couple has kept their personal life largely private since their marriage in September 2024.

items.title: Mahesh Babu hails 'Ramayana'; calls Ranbir, Yash, Sai Pallavi ‘magical’
items.body: <![CDATA[Nitesh Tiwari's latest cinematic venture, 'Ramayana: Part 1', is receiving rave reviews from audiences. The film boasts stellar performances from a talented cast including Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Ravie Dubey, and Yash. Renowned actor Mahesh Babu has lauded the film for its artistic representation of cherished childhood tales, emphasizing its emotional resonance and stunning visuals. The buzz surrounding the film's triumph is palpable, exciting both viewers and industry insiders alike.

items.title: Seeman vs Tamil Producers: Actor EXPLAINS his concern about TN 6 AM shows
items.body: <![CDATA[Seeman raised valid concerns about the Tamil Nadu government's decision to permit early morning film screenings. In response, the Tamil Film Active Producers Association argued that this move enhances the industry's competitiveness. Seeman questioned the need for six showings starting as early as 6 AM for each film release, stressing the effect on younger audiences and their daily responsibilities.

items.title: Director Lenin Bharathi slams Kamal Haasan over 'KH 237' revenge tagline
items.body: <![CDATA[Kamal Haasan has unveiled his upcoming film 'KH 237', helmed by director Su Arun Kumar. The film's promotional tagline has drawn sharp criticism from director Lenin Bharathi, who emphasizes the necessity for filmmakers to be mindful of the messages they convey to younger audiences. Bharathi's remarks raise vital questions about cinema's impact on societal behavior and youth culture, further intensifying the buzz surrounding the film's anticipated release.

items.title: Vidyut urges Tiger stay fearless: actor recalls chat after firing
items.body: <![CDATA[Vidyut Jammwal revealed he urged Tiger Shroff not to “restrict himself” after the October 18 firing incident in Mumbai, calling the actor’s stress understandable. He explained his viral video questioned why bystanders didn’t intervene, and said he enjoyed the resulting memes, even reposting them, without being bothered by the trolling.

items.title: Suriya, Nazriya and Naslen's 'Scene' OTT release date
items.body: <![CDATA[Suriya's latest film 'Scene', a gripping crime thriller helmed by Jithu Madhavan, has hit theaters to rave reviews. Audiences are captivated by the film's fresh narrative and standout performances. With Netflix acquiring its digital streaming rights, 'Scene' is set for a home viewing experience four weeks post-theatrical release. The film's box office performance will play a pivotal role in determining its OTT launch timeline.

items.title: Vijay Sethupathi’s ‘Pocket Novel’ set for Pongal 2027 release
items.body: <![CDATA[The eagerly awaited film 'Pocket Novel', starring Vijay Sethupathi, is set to hit theaters on January 14, 2027, perfectly timed with the Pongal festivities across India. Noteworthy changes include the transition of music direction from Ilaiyaraaja to GV Prakash, who is now officially involved. Actress Malavika Mohanan expressed her excitement about the project, commending both her director and co-star.

items.title: Farah on scolding SRK: Choreographer recalls why he wanted her to yell
items.body: <![CDATA[Farah Khan revealed Amitabh Bachchan was the only actor she never dared to scold on set. Appearing on Double Date, she recalled how Shah Rukh Khan urged her to shout at him so the crew knew she treated everyone equally, and described him as one of the sweetest, most hardworking stars.

items.title: Yash reveals why he chose to play Ravana in ‘Ramayana’ making video
items.body: <![CDATA[Yash's portrayal of Ravana in 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' has received positive audience feedback. In a behind-the-scenes video, Yash explains his motivation for taking on the complex role. Producer Namit Malhotra and director Nitesh Tiwari discuss the character's multidimensional nature. Ranbir Kapoor commended Yash's performance, highlighting the difficulty of representing Ravana accurately.

items.title: Renu Desai compares life after Pawan Kalyan divorce to Ram’s exile
items.body: <![CDATA[Renu Desai has voiced her displeasure at being labeled merely as Pawan Kalyan's ex-wife, akin to Lord Ram's exile from his kingdom. Since their divorce in 2012, she has actively worked on her career, achieving success across numerous projects. Despite facing harsh criticism online, Renu's dedication to her animal rescue NGO highlights her unwavering commitment to uplifting animal welfare and carving her own identity.

Conservationists are now evaluating strategies to eradicate these non-native animals from the islands. Removal efforts could lead to improved nesting conditions for seabirds in the future. Successful initiatives may help restore these vital habitats for future generations.

The father elaborates on their clever sleeping arrangements to facilitate the children's education. This touching depiction of their living conditions has resonated with audiences online, igniting vital discussions about housing challenges faced in urban environments.

items.title: Julia Child's former home sells for $6.525m; famous kitchen now in museum
items.body: Julia Child’s iconic home in Cambridge, Massachusetts, has found a new owner for $6.525 million. This historic residence, adored for its connection to Child's culinary shows, has seen extensive renovations. The original kitchen, however, remains untouched and is now a cherished exhibit at the Smithsonian Museum. To honor her legacy, a commemorative plaque is set to be installed at the site, ensuring that Child's influence on cooking continues.

items.body: IndiGo has made significant strides by onboarding 600 pilots in just the first half of this fiscal year. With plans to hire an additional 400 by March 2024, the airline is focused on compliance with pilot duty regulations and strategic international expansion. Given the current geopolitical climate, which is influencing operating costs like aviation turbine fuel, IndiGo is evaluating potential fuel hedging strategies to support its long-haul service growth.

Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf’s parenting choice kept their children away from tennis spotlight
items.body: Tennis legends Steffi Graf and Andre Agassi have two children, Jaden and Jaz, but neither followed their parents into professional tennis. Jaden pursued baseball, playing for USC and later representing Team Germany in World Baseball Classic Qualifiers. Jaz developed interests in dancing and horseback riding. The couple deliberately avoided putting sporting pressure on their children, choosing instead to let them discover their own passions and identities.

items.body: The year 2026 revealed the public's fascination with various prominent personalities through trending Google searches. Kylie Jenner's memorable runway moments sparked widespread dialogue, cementing her family's media dominance. Meanwhile, Lindsay Clancy's trial shed light on critical postpartum mental health issues. Nicole Kidman's virality underscored her timeless appeal, while fans united in sorrow over the passing of Hayden Panettiere and Dolly Parton.

items.title: Florida man selling $500K home finds $10 deed; ex-wife charged with felony
items.body: A Florida man preparing to sell his home, which he estimates is worth $500,000, discovered a disputed quitclaim deed listing $10 in consideration and allegedly affecting his ownership stake. His former wife, Sharon Joy Barnett, faces a first-degree felony identity-fraud charge. The former couple purchased the Margate property for approximately $265,000 in 2006.

items.title: Stephen Curry-backed Howard golf teams win historic titles in 2026
items.body: Howard University's golf program reached new heights when both men's and women's teams won their conference championships. The women's team claimed its first-ever Northeast Conference title in April 2026. Just days later, the men's team secured its third consecutive NEC championship victory. The successes highlighted the growth of the program, supported by NBA star Stephen Curry's funding.

Howards Sterns honor late dog Bianca with cat adoption center, 2,000 rescues
items.body: After the heartbreaking passing of their bulldog, Howard and Beth Stern channeled their sorrow into meaningful change by founding Bianca's Furry Friends Feline Adoption Center, part of North Shore Animal League America. This center improves the conditions for cats waiting for adoption and boosts rescue capabilities. With over 2,000 cats fostered since 2013, Beth's dedicated efforts have played a crucial role in spotlighting the importance of adopting shelter animals nationwide.

items.title: Orphaned Chinese groom invites strangers; over 10,000 attend his wedding
items.body: In a heartwarming turn of events, Xu Chenghong from Yiliang county opened the doors to his wedding, inviting strangers to make up for his small number of relatives. This seemingly simple invitation captured the internet's attention, resulting in over 10,000 guests from all corners of China attending, bringing food and decorations to contribute to the festivities.

items.title: Glenn Maxwell announces retirement from international cricket
items.body: Maxwell, popularly known as 'The Big Show', represented Australia in 149 ODIs, 130 T20Is and seven Test matches. He was part of Australia's 2015 and 2023 ODI World Cup-winning teams and also played a key role in the team's T20 World Cup triumph in 2021.

items.title: Sexiest Man Alive Noah Wyle says raising son was harder than daughters
items.body: Noah Wyle shares insights on raising his son and two daughters, noting that boys often demand closer attention in their formative years. While girls might appear more manageable initially, they can pose distinct challenges as they mature. He stresses the value of age-appropriate, honest dialogue with kids, recognizing that diverse parenting strategies are essential to meet his children's unique requirements.

items.title: US on right AI track; robots take jobs, right tax system needed: Larry Ellison
items.body: Larry Ellison emphasizes that AI advancements could lead to increased productivity and economic growth. He suggests that taxing the value generated by robots could replace traditional labor taxation methods. This approach could support a universal high income, improving living standards for individuals. Ellison believes that while some jobs may be displaced, automation will create opportunities for more efficient work.

The team plans to adopt a flexible approach for the No. 5 and No. 6 batting positions during the matches. Axar Patel and KL Rahul will take on these roles based on the match situation, ensuring adaptability. Gill also addressed concerns regarding his previous neck issue, asserting he is fit to play.

Anurag Kashyap fails to appear despite summonses; court issues bailable warrant against him
items.body: <![CDATA[A Surat court recently issued a bailable warrant for director Anurag Kashyap following his failure to appear in court. This legal action stems from his controversial comments on social media concerning the Brahmin community, prompted by a complaint from lawyer Kamlesh Raval. The court's directive came after attempts to summon him publicly were unsuccessful, with a subsequent hearing scheduled for December 24.

items.title: Juhi Chawla wishes 'King for the World' Shah Rukh Khan on his 61st birthday
items.body: <![CDATA[Juhi Chawla extended heartfelt birthday greetings to her longtime friend Shah Rukh Khan, reminiscing about their enduring bond and delightful shared experiences. She praised his humility and generosity, while fellow industry peers also joined in the celebrations. As he gears up for the release of his much-anticipated film 'King' on December 24, 2026, excitement swells among fans, bolstered by glimpses of captivating dialogues and scenes shared outside Mannat.

items.title: Salman Khan wishes Shah Rukh Khan on his 61st birthday: 'Hamesha Jawaan raho the King'
items.body: <![CDATA[Salman Khan celebrated Shah Rukh Khan's 61st birthday with a heartfelt music video shared on social media. In spite of ongoing renovations at Mannat, Shah Rukh warmly greeted fans from the podium, dressed casually. The actor connected with the crowd before heading to an intimate dinner with family and friends in South Mumbai. Meanwhile, Salman is busy with his upcoming film Maatrubhumi, expected to release in 2026.

items.title: SRK and Deepika fans spot 'Om Shanti Om' parallels in 'King'
items.body: <![CDATA[Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone's song 'Tu Mil Jaaye' has drawn parallels to their earlier film 'Om Shanti Om'. Fans have noted similarities in romantic sequences and a potential tragic narrative in 'King'. Noteworthy is the speculation around a fire sequence possibly foreshadowing Deepika's character's fate. This has led to discussions about the recurring theme of her characters meeting tragic ends in SRK films.

items.title: Bombay HC grants 'Ramayana' dynamic injunction
items.body: <![CDATA[The Bombay High Court granted an interim injunction against copyright infringement for 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend'. Godpower Media Private Limited sought protection for the film's script, characters, and recordings. Justice Madhav Jamdar recognized the risk of unauthorized distribution ahead of the film's release on November 5. The injunction covers unknown entities and mandates internet platforms to block infringing content. The court will hear the matter again on December 16.

items.title: 'The Batman Part II' cast member RUN OVER by Batmobile: Reports
items.body: <![CDATA[Filming on 'The Batman Part II' recently faced a halt following a mishap with a stunt involving the Batmobile. A cast member was reportedly injured but is now recovering at home after receiving treatment. The production has resumed at Leavesden Studios with Robert Pattinson reprising his role as Bruce Wayne. Speculation continues about potential villains' roles and character casting, including an intriguing reference to the Court of Owls.

items.title: 'Jailer 2' BO day 19: Rajinikanth's film nears Vijay's 'The GOAT'
items.body: <![CDATA[Rajinikanth's latest blockbuster 'Jailer 2' has achieved an impressive Rs 812 crore in global earnings within just 19 days. The film collected Rs 459.70 crore domestically and an additional Rs 274.25 crore from international markets. Despite a notable decline of 69.6% in collections on Monday, the Tamil version remains a frontrunner at the box office, nearing Vijay's 'The Greatest of All Time' in Tamil Nadu.

items.title: 'Ranabaali' needs over Rs 3 cr for budget recovery
items.body: <![CDATA[Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's 'Ranabaali' has seen a decline in box office collections since its release. The film has earned Rs 58.48 crore net in India, reaching a worldwide gross of Rs 80.27 crore. Domestic earnings dropped significantly by 44.7% in recent days, with limited additions expected. The film requires over Rs 3 crore to recover its reported budget of Rs 84 crore.

items.title: Yash, Sai and Ranbir promote 'Ramayana' in London - PICS
items.body: <![CDATA[The promotional campaign for 'Ramayana' has reached London, with the cast and director engaging with international media. Following the film’s premiere in Los Angeles, the team participated in discussions and posed for photos. Advance bookings for the film have reached approximately USD 4.71 million, with a focus on North America. Special screenings and previews are scheduled for November 4 before the official release on November 5.

items.title: 'AK 47' BO day 4: Venkatesh's film behind 'Sankranthiki Vasthunam'
items.body: <![CDATA[The film 'Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47', starring Venkatesh Daggubati and Srinidhi Shetty, is experiencing a worrying decline in box office earnings. On Monday, it brought in a mere Rs 3.40 crore net, marking a significant fall from the previous day's collections. Four days into its release, its total worldwide gross is now at Rs 55.65 crore.

items.title: Drishyam 3 BO: Day 32 weekday haul plunges 68.6%
items.body: <![CDATA[‘Drishyam 3’ is nearing the end of its theatrical run. On its fifth Monday, it earned an estimated Rs 55 lakh net on Day 32, a 68.6 per cent drop from the previous day, as per Sacnilk. India net stands at Rs 377.90 crore, with worldwide gross at Rs 585.49 crore, over five times its Rs 110 crore budget.

items.title: Rimi Tomy announces November wedding
items.body: <![CDATA[Rimi Tomy confirmed her upcoming marriage to Libin Mathew, a bodybuilder and her fitness coach. The couple plans a private wedding ceremony in Dombivli, Mumbai, this November. Rimi shared details about their connection, noting they felt an instant bond during their first meeting. She requested that her former husband not be dragged into discussions about her new relationship.

items.title: Vivienne Jolie legally drops her father Brad Pitt’s surname
items.body: <![CDATA[Vivienne Jolie has successfully received legal permission to forgo her father Brad Pitt's surname, embracing her identity fully. This change marks her as the fourth child of Angelina Jolie to make such a decision. Even though she has identified as Vivienne Jolie since 2024, her siblings have followed suit, save for Pax, who retains the Jolie-Pitt name. The divorce between Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt concluded in December 2024.

items.title: 'Cult' BO day 4: Vishwak Sen's faces weekday test
items.body: <![CDATA[Vishwak Sen's latest Telugu film 'Cult' has seen a notable decline in its box office performance after the initial weekend. With net earnings of Rs 55 lakh on its fourth day, it marks a downward trend, bringing its total worldwide gross to Rs 5.20 crore within four days. However, advance bookings for the fifth day suggest a potential rebound in audience interest.
